title: usage
description: A reading of the Claude subscription's usage windows. Written by usage-check, which the loop runs on its schedule. Shows how close the device is to a rate limit.

available.description: true when a reading was had; false when no source gave one (then every reading field is null). A spend reading has available true and null window fields.

five_hour_pct.description: Percent of the five-hour window used, rounded up.

seven_day_pct.description: Percent of the most used seven-day window, rounded up.

source.description: Where the reading came from; null when unavailable. spend is a spend reading against a budget, which has null window fields.

auth.description: Which login the reading was taken under.

spend_usd.description: Dollars spent in the current budget period up to the reading.

budget_usd.description: The budget for that period, in dollars.

reasons.description: When unavailable: why, one code per source tried, for example statusline:bad-snapshot; empty otherwise.
